desc: Bridging the gap between the B-14 and Premier Series, Bergara brings you the B-14 Wilderness Series. This series tackles the need for rifles that can withstand the rugged and unforgiving wilderness while blending into those very same elements - hence Bergara's hand-painted camouflage stocks with added webbing for increased texture and grip. All Wilderness Series barreled actions feature Sniper Grey Cerakote finishes for advanced protection in extremely harsh weather. The B-14 Wilderness Series features an American-style synthetic stock with SoftTouch finish. This rifle is also outfitted with a hinged floor plate. The world-renowned (#4) Bergara barrel is finished in Sniper Grey. The Wilderness is complemented by Bergara's super-smooth B-14 Action, which is a two-lug system with a sliding plate extractor and a coned bolt nose and breech to ensure smooth feeding and extraction of the cartridge.
